title: SmartLife
description: A realistic evolution 🧬 plugin! Your playstyle (mining ⛏️, fighting ⚔️, building 🧱) dynamically shapes your player's traits 📈, mood 😊, and energy ⚡.
body:
🧠 SmartLife

Tired of every player feeling the same? SmartLife is a realistic player evolution plugin that makes your playstyle matter. It silently analyzes how you play—whether you're a builder, a miner, a warrior, or an explorer—and dynamically evolves your player with unique traits, perks, and moods.

No more boring, static gameplay. Your actions have consequences and rewards!

✨ Core Features

📈 1. Personality & Trait Engine

SmartLife tracks your actions to level up 7 distinct traits. The more you do an activity, the better you get, unlocking passive and active perks!

Miner: Increased mining speed and ore yields.

Builder: Build faster and take less fall damage.

Warrior: Deal more damage and gain resistance.

Explorer: Move faster and use less hunger.

Farmer: Get better crop yields and breeding success.

Guardian: Gain defensive bonuses for protecting allies or villagers.

Trader: Get better prices from villagers.

😊 2. Mood System

Your player's mood changes dynamically based on the world around them. Moods provide real-time buffs or debuffs.

Happy: XP boost! (Caused by sleeping well, good weather).

Calm: Increased tool efficiency. (Default state).

Tired: Slower actions, fatigue effects. (Caused by low energy).

Irritated: Deal more damage but feel reckless. (Caused by storms, hunger).

Depressed: Reduced XP gain. (Caused by dying, negative chat).

⚡ 3. Fatigue & Energy System

You have Energy Points (EP) that drain as you perform actions like mining and fighting.

Restore energy by sleeping or using special "Energy Drink" items (default is a Honey Bottle).

If your energy drops below 10 EP, you'll be slowed and weakened until you rest!

🌍 4. Adaptive World

The world reacts to you:

Friendly Players (High Trader trait): Villagers will offer you better trades.

Hostile Players (High Warrior trait): Mobs will see you as a bigger threat and can spot you from further away.

⌨️ Commands

/smartlife info - View your personality, traits, and mood in a GUI.

/smartlife evolve - Check your primary evolution progress.

/smartlife leaderboard - (Coming Soon) See the top evolved players.

/smartlife admin reset <player> - Reset a player's stats.

/smartlife admin set <player> <trait> <level> - Manually set a player's trait.
